newsitem.title: FRANCE: Yemenia to boost Paris-Sana'a cargo capacity.
newsitem.headline: Yemenia to boost Paris-Sana'a cargo capacity.

text.p: Yemenia-Yemen Airways will introduce an Airbus 310 on a twice-weekly service from Paris-Orly to Sana'a via Larnaca thus boosting cargo capacity, the airline's French gsa, ATC, told Reuters.
"From April 1, Yemenia will replace a Boeing 727 passenger aircraft carrying up to five tonnes of bulk freight per flight with an A310 offering 10 to 12 tonnes of palletized capacity," ATC said
"This will mean fewer restrictions on the size and weight of shipments we can accomodate," an ATC spokesman said.

He added: "The change of aircraft amounts to a significant upgrade for Saan'a as an ex-Paris cargo destination. With less restrictions on the size and weight of cargo there is greater scope to develop what is an emerging market."
